name: nba2k16-vita
description: PS Vita port of NBA 2K16 (Android). Own so-loader + native sceGxm renderer. Bring your own APK.
long_description: A PS Vita port of the Android version of NBA 2K16 (v0.0.29). It loads the game's ARM `.so` straight onto the Vita and fakes enough Android around it for the game to think it's on a phone.
